meta.dataset: Refinery Capacity Report (Form EIA-820), refinery capacity by individual refinery as of January 1, 2017; coordinates from the EIA map layer "U.S. Petroleum Refineries" (as of January 1, 2021)
meta.capacityField: QUANTITY where PRODUCT = 'TOTAL OPERABLE CAPACITY' and SUPPLY = 'Atmospheric Crude Distillation Capacity (barrels per calendar day)'
meta.notes: Built by research/scripts/build_historical_fleet.py. Names, owners and capacities are those of January 1, 2017. Positions come from the 2021 EIA layer, joined by state + site (+ company or corporation); 'coordMatch' records which key matched. A refinery that closed or merged before 2021 has no position and is listed in 'unmatchedNoCoordinates'; it is not placed by guesswork. capacityBpd is null where the workbook has no total operable capacity row.
